PreToolUse.description: Enforce agentgate path restrictions on file write operations

PreToolUse:Bash.description: Warn on git commit attempts - must use commit quality gate
PreToolUse:Bash.command: echo 'DENY: Use the commit quality gate (cargo test && git commit) instead of direct git operations. All commits must pass the .agentgate.toml check pipeline.' >&2 && exit 1
